card.name: Patients while on a drug
card.fires_on: The word just before a phrase naming a drug the patient is on, such as "while", "patients" or "stabilized" followed by on, taking or receiving. It appears in interaction and warning sections.

modes.label: while
modes.description: The word "while" before taking, on or receiving a named drug.
modes.example: Patients should not be vaccinated against smallpox<< while>> on corticosteroid therapy.

modes.label: patients before on/taking
modes.description: The word "patients" or "stabilized" right before on or taking a drug.
modes.example: Patients<< stabilized>> on oral anticoagulants who

card.writes: It promotes words like on, onto and receiving, which fit the phrase "on [drug]" or "receiving [drug]".
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "on" or "taking" a drug, as in "patients on warfarin".
